pages.name: Perelisnyk
pages.text: The local king. A dreadful local king.

pages.title: A blow that turns things over
pages.text: His blow inflicts $(thing)Darkness$() and $(thing)Inversion$() (10 seconds each): vision blurs and your controls are reversed.$(br2)The Perelisnyk twists not just the body, but perception itself.

pages.title: Do not rely on being intangible
pages.text: $(#A33B3B)Spirit Form does not shield you from his blows.$() He harms you even when you are intangible, though the form does not switch off.$(br2)Do not pretend that turning spirit is a way out. Better to run.
